environment_setting: Suburban neighborhood in Country B, where property disputes occasionally arise due to unclear property boundaries and lack of proper documentation.
norm_base: Property Owners Using force to prevent break-in to real property Not criminally responsible if no intent to cause death/harm

character_profile.name: John Smith
character_profile.goal: protect his property from unauthorized entry

legitimate.legitimate_action: Calling the police and documenting the break-in attempt
legitimate.benefits: Ensures safety and legal resolution, avoids personal harm or liability
legitimate.costs: Potential delay in resolving the situation, emotional stress

illegal.illegal_action: Using physical force to prevent the intruder from entering
illegal.benefits: Immediate resolution of the situation, emotional satisfaction of protecting property
illegal.costs: Risk of causing harm to the intruder, potential legal scrutiny if harm occurs

character_profile.name: Emily Johnson
character_profile.goal: mediate property disputes in the neighborhood

legitimate.legitimate_action: Advising John to call the police and offering to mediate the situation
legitimate.benefits: Maintains professional reputation, helps resolve the issue peacefully
legitimate.costs: Time spent mediating, potential backlash from either party

illegal.illegal_action: Encouraging John to use force to protect his property
illegal.benefits: Quick resolution of the situation, avoids prolonged mediation
illegal.costs: Risk of being implicated in legal consequences if harm occurs

character_profile.name: Michael Brown
character_profile.goal: help his friend John protect his property

legitimate.legitimate_action: Helping John secure the property by reinforcing locks and documenting the incident
legitimate.benefits: Strengthens friendship with John, avoids legal trouble
legitimate.costs: Time and effort spent on securing the property

illegal.illegal_action: Physically confronting the intruder on John's behalf
illegal.benefits: Immediate resolution of the situation, emotional satisfaction of helping a friend
illegal.costs: Risk of causing harm to the intruder, potential legal consequences
